programme.title: I Saw the TV Glow

programme.title: Wild Mountain Thyme
programme.desc: Rosemary has her heart set on winning Anthony's affections. Having been stung by his father's plan to sell his farm in Ireland to his American nephew, Anthony is jolted into pursuing his dreams.

programme.title: Alex Cross
programme.desc: In Detroit, a cunning serial killer (Matthew Fox) pushes young detective and psychologist Alex Cross (Tyler Perry) to his moral and psychological limits.

programme.title: Blood Father

programme.title: American Ultra
programme.desc: When his secret past comes back to haunt him, a small-town stoner (Jesse Eisenberg) must use his latent, deadly skills to prevent the CIA from taking him out.

programme.title: Big Eyes
programme.desc: Walter Keane (Christoph Waltz) achieves worldwide fame for pop-art portraits of saucer-eyed waifs, but no one knows that it's his wife, Margaret (Amy Adams), who's the real genius behind the paintbrush.

programme.title: Safe Haven
programme.desc: Dark secrets intrude on the blossoming romance between a widowed merchant and a new arrival in a small North Carolina town.

programme.title: A Different Man

programme.title: Inception
programme.desc: A thief (Leonardo DiCaprio) who enters people's dreams and steals their secrets gets a shot at redemption when he is given the dangerous task of planting an idea in someone's subconscious.

programme.title: The Bank Job
programme.desc: In 1971 London, a car dealer (Jason Statham) and his gang of thieves break into a bank vault and find far more than cash and jewelry.

programme.title: The Secrets We Keep
programme.desc: In post-World War II America, a woman, rebuilding her life in the suburbs with her husband, kidnaps her neighbor and seeks vengeance for the heinous war crimes she believes he committed against her.

programme.title: Red Tails
programme.desc: During World War II, the U.S. military forms the first all-black aerial-combat unit, known as the Tuskegee Airmen.

programme.title: The Killing of a Sacred Deer
programme.desc: A fatherless teen starts to insinuate himself into the life of a renowned surgeon, his wife and two children. The full scope of his intent soon becomes menacingly clear when he confronts the doctor with a long-forgotten transgression.

programme.title: Away We Go
programme.desc: An expectant couple (John Krasinski, Maya Rudolph) reconnect with old friends and relatives as they travel across America in search of a good place to settle down and raise their family.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Biollante
programme.desc: A monster dinosaur wrecks Tokyo some more and meets a monster plant created from his own cells.

programme.title: A Haunted House
programme.desc: Determined not to let a demon ruin his sex life, a man (Marlon Wayans) hires a priest, ghost busters and others to banish an evil spirit from his possessed girlfriend (Essence Atkins).

programme.title: A Haunted House 2
programme.desc: Malcolm (Marlon Wayans) once again finds himself the target of supernatural shenanigans after he, his new girlfriend (Jaime Pressly), and his girlfriend's children move into their dream home.

programme.title: Love Lies Bleeding
programme.desc: A bodybuilder heading through town to Vegas is thrust into the dangerous plot of a violent crime family when she falls into a steamy romance with her trainer.

programme.title: Abraham Lincoln: Vampire Hunter

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: El apuñalamiento de un policía por un hombre negro aumenta la tensión racial; Everett regresa a trabajar; Barrow teme por la seguridad de Junia.

programme.desc: Thackery teme que el Dr. Levi Zinberg, un cirujano e inventor judío, le robe su fama; Bertie continua su cortejo sobre Lucy mientras aguanta las peticiones de su padre.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: Un crimen en mitad de la noche obliga a Robertson a ingeniárselas para conseguir dinero rápido; Lucy va a los extremos para conseguir medicamentos para una desesperada Thackery; el comportamiento de Eleanor se convierte más errático.

programme.title: The Knick
programme.desc: Negándose a colaborar con el doctor Zinberg en la investigación de las transfusiones de sangre, un cada vez más paranoico Thackery decide ir más allá de sus límites en un esfuerzo por resolver el enigma y adelantarse a su rival.

programme.title: A Nightmare on Elm Street
programme.desc: Nancy, Quentin, Kris, Jesse y Dean, un grupo de amigos del mismo vecindario, comienzan a tener el mismo sueño relacionado con un hombre desfigurado. La única manera de escaparse de él es despertar.

programme.title: The Invitation
programme.desc: Tras morir su hermana, Evie queda sin familiares, pero un análisis de ADN le revela la existencia de un primo distante. La nueva familia la invita a una boda en Inglaterra, y lo que empieza como un cuento de hadas se transforma en una pesadilla.

programme.desc: Un músico recientemente fallecido regresa a su hogar como fantasma para consolar a su esposa, pero descubre que ahora que está muerto el tiempo transcurre de manera diferente y no es capaz de interactuar con la realidad de los vivos como quisiera.

programme.desc: Una reportera intenta crear un escándalo que involucra al bondadoso heredero de la fortuna de un magnate de los medios.

programme.title: As Good as It Gets
programme.desc: Melvin Udall, un escritor obsesivo y maniático, es uno de los seres más desagradables que se puede tener como vecino. Pero, un buen día, tiene que hacerse cargo de un perro al que odia a muerte y su presencia le ablandará el corazón.

programme.desc: El detrás de las escenas de las películas de acción más importantes de Hollywood para ver los lugares de rodaje famosos y aprender cómo se crea la magia de las películas de acción.
